promptEs: En Mi♭ mayor, ¿en qué grado resuelve V/ii?
promptEn: In E♭ major, which degree does V/ii resolve to?
explanationEs: En Mi♭ mayor, V/ii es Do7 y resuelve en Fam (ii). Su tercera es la sensible de Fam y sube un semitono al resolver.
explanationEn: In E♭ major, V/ii is C7 and it resolves to Fm (ii). Its third is the leading tone of Fm and rises a semitone when it resolves.
